events.title: HINO is coming to gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026 — Play the Demo!
events.summary: HINO is heading to gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026 in Bangkok, Thailand!Visitors can play the HINO demo at the show. Journey through a ballpoint-pen-drawn world of darkness with Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the Monimoni Skeleton.■ Event Overview • Event: gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026 • Dates: Friday, October 30 – Sunday, November 1, 2026 (Entertainment Area) • Hours: 9:30 AM – 8:00 PM • Venue: Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC), Bangkok, Thailand • Booth: F
